'''Tarrin Datch''' was an [[X-wing starfighter]] [[pilot]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Rogue Squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. At the [[Battle of Hoth]] they served during the evacuation of [[Echo Base]], escorting the last [[GR-75 medium transport]], the ''[[Bright Hope]]'', away from [[Hoth]] with fellow pilots [[Wes Janson]] and [[Wedge Antilles]].<ref name="Complete Locations" />
